question: Under blind random-ω stitched-Sobol + 6-DOF LM, does the s011 lowest-surrogate-MSE cohort selector still return near-truth landings?
hypothesis: Joint (q0, ω) search under random-ω yields ~0 in-basin landings on seed 6 (tube-volume argument) and the s011 cohort selector breaks under joint search.
narrative_md: First joint (q0, ω) inversion pilot under random-ω. Pre-registered tube-volume prediction (0-2/512 on seed 6) confirmed exactly: 0/512 in-basin on the seed-6 smoke, 0/8 cohort yield at N=64. The s011 cohort selector (lowest-surrogate-MSE → Band A truth at fixed truth-ω) is structurally broken under joint search — argmin landings are 80-180° from truth on every seed. Failure mode uniform across n_rotations strata. Architectural pivot required (s016 chain).
